
### single-sign on  {.smaller}


* client $\rightarrow$ foo.com: GET /foo
* foo.com $\rightarrow$ client: redirect to https://sso.com/login?from=foo.com&amp;…
* client $\rightarrow$ sso.com: GET /login?from=foo.com&amp;… 

   * sent with cookies set by sso.com

* sso.com $\rightarrow$ client: web page with form action=http://foo.com/... and method=post 

   * data in form tells foo.com about username, etc.
   * cryptographically signed or similar
   * remember login: possibly script to submit automatically

* client $\rightarrow$ foo.com: POST /... with data from sso.com


### single-sign on and third-party cookie awkwardness 


* single-sign on flow also gives a way to do tracking…
* not ‘third-party’ cookies since the ‘root’ web page becomes the single-sign on site
